subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw continue investing in this native folder-backed encrypted backup flow on this branch, or require a narrower replacement after the security and proof blockers?
rationale: The PR adds core CLI/config/restore surface for sensitive user state, but the current branch is conflicting and still has security-boundary blockers, so automation cannot safely decide the permanent product direction.

options.title: Require branch refresh first
options.body: Keep this PR open only if the contributor rebases it, fixes the listed blockers, and adds real behavior proof for setup/run/list/restore.

options.title: Sponsor a replacement PR
options.body: Use the useful design and tests as source material, but move the work to a maintainer-controlled or ClawSweeper replacement branch with focused security review.

options.title: Defer native snapshots
options.body: Close or pause this branch and leave off-machine or narrower backup work to existing external/plugin paths until core backup direction is revisited.

recommendation.title: Require branch refresh first
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if the contributor rebases it, fixes the listed blockers, and adds real behavior proof for setup/run/list/restore.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent backup docs/test/refactor history makes Peter the best available routing candidate for the core backup product and proof decision.
